title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #13: Florida Mts. and Laguna de Guzman (playa)
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#13" with "N" at top. Handwritten labels include "Florida Mts." and "Laguna de Guzman (playa)" along with names of several sierras, and dashed lines mark the border. Vertical streaks cross the print.
